dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Exactly, exactly! I've got all the latest scoop on things happening outside Inazuma right here — the freshest intel, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Have you heard? A giant dragon appeared in Mondstadt to the north some time earlier.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: The dragon's wings were enough to blot out the sun, and it sent furious storms whirling right into the center of Mondstadt...

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Hehe, interested? Well, if you wanna hear more, I'm afraid you're going to have to pay up...
